description: Per-map list of decal Blueprint assets that are preloaded when a battle on that map starts.

ID.simple: Map ID that owns the decal list.
ID.technical: FName row key, generally the same MAP_xx as MapDataTable.ID. The current map row's Id_MapDecal is resolved against MapDecalDataTables (+0x3C0) in battle preload (retail 0x12bd690); NAME_None skips the join. Export has 5 such rows (e.g. MAP_01).

Filename.simple: Decal Blueprint asset names used by this map.
Filename.technical: Serialized C++ property TArray<FName> FileName (16 slots in every exported row, unused slots are NAME_None). BattleAssets_MapDecals appends all entries, including None, to the preload name list; GamePrimaryAssetLoader_CreateLoaders then creates Decal-type loaders keyed by these names, stored in StudioMapDecalLoaders_1D0 until the preload gate is satisfied. Export examples: DCL_01310_BP ... DCL_01370_BP for MAP_01. The field is a Blueprint asset name list, not a list of DecalDataTable row IDs, although the prefixes often correspond.

notes: MapDecalDataTables is manager slot +0x3C0; the 'MapDecalDataTable' name is registered as a primary asset loader at GameDataTableManager.cpp:338 and resolved at line 190.

Only one direct consumer of this row type exists in the available source: battle preload (0x12bd690). No gameplay code in this tree spawns these decals itself; spawning would go through the generic DecalDataTable/AGameRenderManager path after the assets are loaded. Blueprint content is unavailable, so no additional uses are claimed.
Export key 'Filename' maps to the case-different C++ property FileName.

usages.detail: BattleAssets_MapDecals resolves the map's Id_MapDecal row and appends its FileName list to the requested asset names (retail 0x12bd690).
Battle preload looks up the current battle map row and calls the collector for map decals.
Creates Decal primary asset loaders from the collected names and stores them in StudioMapDecalLoaders_1D0; lines 170-175 gate battle start on all loaders completing.
